name: Georgia
sources: Georgia DOR, Individual Income Tax: flat rate 5.19% for tax year 2025 (HB 111, 2025), stepping down 0.10 per year toward 4.99%

Retirement income exclusion, O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5): $35,000 per person age 62-64, $65,000 per person 65+; covers pensions, IRA/401(k) distributions, interest, dividends, capital gains, and up to $5,000 of earned income per person
Social Security benefits are exempt from Georgia income tax
